name: Shredding Machines
summary: In Windshear Crag, Venture Company shredders wound the spirits of Stonetalon. Seereth Stonebreak hears their cries as XT:4 and XT:9 cut through the forest.

sections.title: A Vision of Deforestation
sections.body: Orc shaman Seereth Stonebreak keeps watch along the dusty border between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. She listens to the unseen realm, but chaos drowns much of Stonetalon’s spiritual voice. One vision came through clear: man-shaped contraptions tearing through ancient woods at unnatural speed. Marked XT:4 and XT:9, the goblin-engineered shredders cut Windshear Crag’s timberlands and send waves of distress through the surrounding nature spirits.

sections.title: Silencing the Saws
sections.body: The Venture Company works in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale. To curb the damage, Horde champions go there and hunt down the logging constructs. Wrecking XT:4 and XT:9 strikes at the mountains’ commercial deforestation and quiets the wounded tree spirits’ immediate cries. Seereth warns that unless the Venture Company leaves Stonetalon entirely, far darker atrocities await the land.

faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman posted along the southern border between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. Attuned to the land’s elemental and spiritual forces, she carries the cries of forest spirits anguished by the Venture Company’s rapid expansion.

XT:4 and XT:9 are specialized logging shredders operated by the Venture Company in Windshear Crag. Goblin operators pilot these steam-powered mechanical walkers, which cut ancient timber far faster than manual laborers.

aliases: where do i find the shredders
faq.answer: Windshear Crag lies in the northern reaches of the Stonetalon Mountains, northwest of Greatwood Vale. The Venture Company has turned it into a vast industrial logging basin.

faq.q: Why does a shaman care about trees and druidic magic?
aliases: why do shaman care about trees
faq.answer: Seereth explains that shamanistic communion with spirits shares close ties with druidic nature magic. Harm to living forests echoes through the spirit realm, where perceptive shamans hear slaughtered tree spirits alongside elemental unrest.

faq.q: Who owns and operates these shredders?
faq.answer: The Venture Company owns the shredders. This goblin-run commercial conglomerate is infamous across Azeroth for stripping valuable natural resources without regard for local ecosystems or ancestral inhabitants.

faq.q: Does destroying XT:4 and XT:9 drive the Venture Company away?
faq.answer: No. Destroying these machines quiets the weeping tree spirits and sets back local logging, but the Venture Company keeps an extensive industrial foothold across Windshear Crag. Defenders of the wild must keep resisting its presence.

angles.text: Seereth points to the close ties between spiritual magic and nature. Elemental balance depends on defending the spirits that dwell in the land.
The desecration of Stonetalon’s ancient forests by soulless goblin machinery violates devotion to the Earth Mother.
The XT-series logging mechs show advanced goblin shredder design, joining mechanical hydraulic saws with steam locomotion.
As the Horde establishes footholds across Kalimdor, checking the Venture Company’s unregulated greed helps preserve the land and keep travel through Stonetalon safe.
